scope: Read-only review of current documentation against frozen Scene3D controller, readonly source ports, renderer and actual browser-label-final proof. Source working tree only; no installed desktop, Android device or physical-GPU claim. Historical reports and historical verification counts retain their original scopes.
checks: Current GUI labels are 3D preview, refresh current draft and reset view; existing JSON source is previewed without creating a second Save authority.
Source schema, model/plan boundaries, stable UUIDs, exact UTF-16 object locations, XYZ matrix T*Rx*Ry*Rz*S, right-handed Y-up/-Z convention and authored viewport aspect match implementation.
Strict native budgets and practical camera/light/frustum limits are documented without promising bit-identical float32 raster output.
Invalid source retains the last valid preview; navigation/token guards, context release and unsupported native/WebGL diagnostics are separated from engine-tool availability.
CLI export/check/run are explicit operations and are not represented as GUI export buttons or existing 2D backend-catalog/control/case support.
Optional scene3d read ports and feature disable keep legacy modules intact; module assembly does not grant author write or engine execution permissions.
No textures, physical hierarchy, physics, behavior bindings, OC projection support or 3D authoring transactions are claimed.
Actual narrow-screen proof covers preview/layout; ordinary Save proof uses restored desktop metrics. Browser renderer is SwiftShader and unsupported-WebGL phase is explicitly injected.
Previous module-system and other historical counts remain explicitly associated with their original slices; current 3D increment is linked separately.

resolvedWording.description: The broad Scene2D build sentence was narrowed by the documentation owner to the existing 2D build workbench; this does not revise historical evidence.
